scientific_conclusions: F-GC30 coupling head is hydraulic head at the fixed SWAP lower face, not the diagnosed freatic groundwater level.
For B1.10 prescribed qbot, lower-face pressure head is h_n + d*(1 + qbot/K_n), with d=0.5*dz_n.
Its qbot derivative requires both terminal dh_n/dqbot and dK_n/dqbot and is qualified independently against centered finite difference.
An admitted drainage-free F-KT21 bottom-flux trajectory can now be transformed into an authoritative terminal fixed-face H_bot,end and dH_bot,end/dqbot without mutating state.
Native qbot is positive into SWAP. F-GC30 q_u is positive outward from SWAP, so zero head change gives q_u=-qbot.
The historical coupling coefficient is u=dt/(dH_bot_end/dqbot) in consistent native SWAP length/time units.
accepted_storage_change is not semantically interchangeable with the historical coupling-storage coefficient.
Predictor provenance must not reuse groundwater_interface_lineage_t because its groundwater candidate_revision does not yet exist when the SWAP predictor response is formed.
H_bot,start is the previously committed accepted SWAP interface head. It must not be substituted by accepted_h_groundwater_m when a nonzero converged head residual exists.

Centered finite difference remains a contract-level fallback and independent qualification oracle; the qualified production oracle for this drainage-free route replays the accepted two-half B1.10 solver topology directly because the external full-versus-half comparator is an exact identity gate, not a smooth error norm.

The production candidate assembler is non-committing and non-publishing, validates accepted origin/candidate/result/window/trajectory provenance through existing public seams, and recovers native qbot only as -terminal_bottom_outward_flux_native.
The production FD qualification oracle is not itself a runtime finite-difference fallback and must not be generalized to missing active-process physics such as drainage.
Existing kernel candidate/result APIs proved sufficient to bind the drainage-free production predictor candidate without opening private state or introducing a parallel runtime.

The qualified production tangent and centered-FD oracle use the prescribed-qbot model-certificate candidate route from one immutable origin; the FD trials disable tangent publication and perturb only qbot.
The exact EXTERNAL_FULL_HALF state-identity comparator is not a smooth perturbation acceptance route and is not relaxed for F-GC30 qualification.
